evidence: CVE Program record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-61460 is state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn) for CWE-639: authenticated users can edit/update/delete records owned by others in LeadController, PersonController, OrganizationController, QuoteController, and ActivityController through 2.2.3.

Vendor issue https://github.com/krayin/laravel-crm/issues/2559 documents source-to-sink: packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Http/Middleware/Bouncer.php authorizes only the current route name; packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Bouncer.php::getAuthorizedUserIds() is an opt-in owner-scope helper; listing/view apply it, while edit/update/destroy take a request-controlled id.

At tag v2.2.3 (6cda4f6297042d74769c38fcbc1b7ebe6df54ab6), LeadController::edit/update/updateAttributes/updateStage/destroy/massUpdate/massDestroy resolve $id from the request and call findOrFail/update/delete with no owner comparison, while view(), search(), and get() call bouncer()->getAuthorizedUserIds(). Person/Organization/Quote/Activity mutation methods follow the same unscoped findOrFail/update/delete pattern.

dc012873261e9c5cac3693c3f8098b4dcc808bd8 (2021-06-08, subject 'Added check in lead data grid for permission') is the first public commit that enforces individual ownership on record discovery: it adds `where('leads.user_id', $user->id)` when lead_view_permission == 'individual' in packages/Webkul/Admin/src/DataGrids/Lead/LeadDataGrid.php, while LeadController::view/update/destroy already existed as unscoped findOrFail/update/delete on request ids.

git log -S 'leads.user_id' --until=2021-06-09 shows only f450fe7d9634624b6530c4d265811f3525c173b7 (join for display) before this commit; no earlier owner filter exists. Later 9cbd134a63b3317675972483dd8e60e6bf6f74c4 only adds the view() check and 57b53f31bf737597e6e7d9d85e026795ac103815 only refactors the same helper; they are not first-writes of the list-scoped/direct-ID-unscoped CWE-639 gap.

Immediate parent de14da37d1583af11d320e215c52ecd0044f2562:packages/Webkul/Admin/src/DataGrids/Lead/LeadDataGrid.php::prepareQueryBuilder() has the leads/users joins but no lead_view_permission test and no leads.user_id WHERE filter.

The same parent tree's LeadController already exposes view($id)/update($id)/destroy($id) via findOrFail/update/delete with no ownership comparison, so the disclosed listing-vs-direct-ID asymmetry is absent until dc012873261e9c5cac3693c3f8098b4dcc808bd8.
